name: Stephanie A. Capps
office: Altadena Library District, Member, Board of Trustees, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Stephanie A. Capps is an emergency nurse educator. In her candidate statement, she said she has worked as a registered nurse for 15 years and that public libraries play an essential role in strengthening communities, especially as Altadena recovers from the Eaton Fire.
